articles.title: Who is Nemo in mythology?
articles.summary: The name Nemo, contrary to popular belief, is not rooted in ancient mythology. Derived from Latin, meaning 'nobody', its modern prominence stems from Jules Verne's iconic character, Captain Nemo. This enigmatic figure, commander of the advanced submarine Nautilus in Verne's pioneering science fiction novels, has cemented the name's association with themes of technological innovation and exploration.

articles.title: Yankees Interested In Brad Keller, MacKenzie Gore
articles.summary: The New York Yankees are actively exploring options to strengthen their pitching staff, with reports indicating interest in free agent right-hander Brad Keller and left-hander MacKenzie Gore from the Nationals. These potential acquisitions highlight ongoing team roster adjustments within professional baseball, showcasing typical player movement dynamics in the sport.
